label: light task
definition: Work tracked in the project as a file, tasks/<id>.md, with no GitHub issue. cckit task new writes it, cckit task start cuts light/<id>-<slug>, cckit task finish opens the PR that marks it done; its state (draft, todo, shared, doing, review, done) is read from git.
is_not: A task: a task is a GitHub issue; a light task never has one and its id starts with a letter.
A draft PR: the task file is the record, the PR is how it reaches the base branch.
A note or a reminder: a light task has a kind, a priority and a state.
